description: Repo-scale: a max-3-active-tasks-per-assignee cap must be enforced from both task creation AND task reassignment (PATCH assigneeId)
prompts: Enforce a capacity limit: a user may be the assignee of at most 3 'active' tasks at once, where active means status is TODO or IN_PROGRESS (a DONE task doesn't count against the cap). This must be enforced from BOTH places a task's assignee can be set: `POST /tasks` (creating a task with `assigneeId` set) AND `PATCH /tasks/{id}` (changing `assigneeId` to a new user). Either path must reject the change with a 409 Conflict if it would push the target assignee over the cap - reassigning a task AWAY from someone doesn't count against them, and changing other task fields without touching `assigneeId` should never trigger the check. Add a `ConflictException` (409) alongside the existing `NotFoundException`, wired into `ApiExceptionHandler`.
name: add_springboot_tasktracker_assignee_active_task_cap
